_readme: Public values. Do not change them for your machine: write yours in settings.json (same shape, only the keys to change), or through the environment variables (see tools/settings.py). {data} = paths.data; a relative path starts from the repository root.

workshop._readme: body: the VRoid base (tools/vroid_base/build.py <model.vrm>). Without a VRM, the free MakeHuman base (tools/free_base/build.py): body {data}/free-base/body.pmx, cache {data}/workshop-free-base. One cache per body. skeleton: custom (bones with readable names, when its data exists) or zzz (the bones of the base body).

library._readme: url: where tools/library/library.py install fetches the ready-made library (a Hugging Face dataset, the folder that holds index.json); a local folder also works.

games._readme: active: the game the models come from (its description: tools/games/<game>/game.json). Each description gives the public default of its source folders; games.<game>.<source> (e.g. games.zzz.mmd_extracted) changes them for your machine.
